review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Description & Requirements The Network Engineer is responsible for the implementation, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and support of the firm's enterprise network infrastructure. Adhere to documented procedures, change-management processes, quality-control requirements, and security standards. Partner with cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance requirements. Assist with capacity planning and future infrastructure requirements. Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of relevant experience in enterprise network engineering, administration, or support. Hands-on experience configuring, supporting, and troubleshooting enterprise networking technologies, including Cisco platforms. Experience supporting networking technologies within Microsoft Azure Preferred Qualifications Python, Teraform, or similar automation experience.
